rows.ja: 発電・原子力の提携先

companies.name: ナショナル・グリッド

relations.text: 2022年5月、ロードアイランドの電力・ガス会社Narragansett ElectricをNational GridからPPLが買収
relations.text_en: PPL bought Narragansett Electric (Rhode Island Energy) from National Grid in May 2022

source.label: PPL 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On May 25, 2022, PPL Rhode Island Holdings acquired 100% of the outstanding shares of common stock of Narragansett Electric from National Grid U.S., a subsidiary of National Grid plc (the Acquisition).

relations.text: データセンター向け発電の合弁を組む(PPL 51%、Blackstone Infrastructure 49%)
relations.text_en: Joint venture for data center power generation (PPL 51%, Blackstone Infrastructure 49%)

source.label: PPL 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: PPL owns 51% of the joint venture interest and Blackstone Infrastructure owns 49%.

relations.text: PPLの送配電子会社・PJMとTalenの3者で、原子力発電所の接続契約の変更を申請(FERCが2024年に却下)
relations.text_en: Talen, PJM and a PPL subsidiary sought an amended interconnection agreement for its nuclear plant (FERC denied it in 2024)

source.label: Talen Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the FERC issued an order denying an Amended Interconnection Service Agreement (the "ISA Amendment") between PJM, a subsidiary of PPL Corporation, and Susquehanna

relations.text: PPL傘下のLG&E・KUと、ケンタッキー州でのSMR導入を検討する協力
relations.text_en: Collaborating with PPL's LG&E and KU to explore Xe-100 SMRs in Kentucky

source.label: X-energy の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: Announced a collaboration with LG&E and KU, subsidiaries of PPL Corporation, to explore deploying Xe-100 SMRs in Kentucky

companies.name: ONEニュークリア・エナジー

relations.text: 開発計画の提携先の一社がPPL
relations.text_en: PPL is one of the partners in its project

source.label: ONE Nuclear Energy の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: The project is partnered with Siemens Energy, Jingoli Power, PPL Corporation and Prysmian Group.
